FINAL AUTONOMOUS HANDOFF — EXECUTE, VERIFY, THEN TRANSFER

This is the final transfer of engineering responsibility from the Rork workspace to the IVX Autonomous system.

The objective is that IVX Autonomous becomes the primary engineering system for IVX Holdings.

Do not leave any engineering workflow dependent on the Rork conversation.

Do not return another plan-only narrative.

Do not simulate progress.

Every completed item must include production evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — AUTONOMOUS OWNERSHIP
==================================================

Verify and enforce the routing rules.

Knowledge requests:
→ IVX IA Chat (LLM)

Architecture reviews:
→ IVX IA Chat

Code reviews:
→ IVX IA Chat

Design discussions:
→ IVX IA Chat

Execution requests:
→ Autonomous Developer Worker

QA requests:
→ Autonomous QA Worker

Deployment requests:
→ Autonomous Deployment Worker

Bug-fix requests:
→ Autonomous Developer Worker

Regression testing:
→ Autonomous QA Worker

Never misroute a request.

Produce routing evidence for every category.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — SENIOR DEVELOPER CONVERSATION
==================================================

IVX IA Chat must answer naturally without unnecessary clarification.

Verify with real production tests:

• React Native
• Expo
• TypeScript
• Node
• Hono
• Supabase
• PostgreSQL
• AWS
• Render
• GitHub
• CI/CD
• Architecture
• Performance
• Security
• Debugging
• Production incidents
• Deployment strategy
• Database design

Run at least 100 mixed developer prompts.

Success criteria:

- No canned responses
- No clarification loops
- No incorrect routing
- Follow-up context maintained
- Clear senior-level explanations

==================================================
PHASE 3 — AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION
==================================================

Every execution request must follow:

Task Created

↓

Worker Assigned

↓

Architecture Review

↓

Implementation

↓

Typecheck

↓

Lint

↓

Unit Tests

↓

Integration Tests

↓

Regression Tests

↓

Security Scan

↓

Git Commit

↓

GitHub Push

↓

CI

↓

Render Deploy

↓

Production Verification

↓

Evidence Stored

↓

Owner Notification

Return evidence for every stage.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — NATURAL CONVERSATION
==================================================

Implement full conversational memory.

The owner must naturally ask:

"What are you doing?"

"What did you fix?"

"What failed?"

"Continue yesterday's task."

"Explain commit XXXXX."

"Show deployment."

"Why is this blocked?"

"What worker is fixing this?"

"What is the highest priority?"

without losing context.

Conversation must support:

• English
• Spanish
• Mixed language
• Imperfect English
• Multi-turn conversations

==================================================
PHASE 5 — DEEP QA
==================================================

Run a complete audit of every subsystem.

Authentication

Registration

Members

Investors

Buyers

Properties

Deals

Reels

Chat

Notifications

Owner Dashboard

Admin Hub

Autonomous Dashboard

IVX IA Chat

Backend

Supabase

Render

AWS

GitHub

CI/CD

Monitoring

Security

Performance

API

Realtime

Offline Recovery

Memory

Voice

Natural Conversation

Every module must return only one of:

PASS

FAIL

BLOCKED

DEVICE REQUIRED

No estimated status.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — AUTONOMOUS INDEPENDENCE
==================================================

Verify that closing the Rork workspace does NOT stop:

IVX IA Chat

Autonomous Workers

QA Scheduler

Deployments

Monitoring

Reports

Task Queue

Realtime Events

Memory

Owner Dashboard

The production system must remain operational independently.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — LIVE OBSERVABILITY
==================================================

The Autonomous Dashboard must become the owner's mission control.

Every card must open real live data.

Implement drill-down for:

• Running jobs
• Queued jobs
• Blocked jobs
• Workers
• Deployments
• Commits
• Tests
• Evidence
• Investors
• Buyers
• Deals
• Outreach
• QA
• Performance
• Security
• Production Health

Every page must show:

Status

Heartbeat

Worker

Logs

Evidence

Files Changed

Commit

Deployment

Production SHA

Next Action

==================================================
PHASE 8 — OWNER COMMUNICATION
==================================================

The owner must communicate directly with Autonomous.

Support:

Text

Voice

Follow-up conversation

Context memory

Task creation

Task control

Approval requests

Deployment requests

Rollback requests

Natural conversation

Autonomous must answer directly.

Do not redirect simple questions.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — FINAL CERTIFICATION
==================================================

Do not mark COMPLETE until production evidence exists.

Return:

GitHub SHA

Render SHA

Production SHA

CI Run ID

Deployment ID

APK Version

AAB Version

iOS Build Status

Tests Executed

Tests Passed

Coverage

Production Health

Regression Status

Security Status

Performance Status

Memory Status

Conversation Status

Autonomous Status

==================================================
FINAL VERIFICATION
==================================================

Return only verified evidence for:

✓ IVX IA Senior Developer
✓ IVX IA Natural Conversation
✓ Autonomous Workers
✓ Autonomous Dashboard
✓ Live Task Control
✓ Memory
✓ Voice
✓ Realtime
✓ QA
✓ Deployments
✓ Monitoring
✓ Evidence
✓ Production Health
✓ GitHub = Render SHA parity
✓ Runtime independence from the Rork workspace

The project is NOT COMPLETE until every verification is backed by production evidence.

The goal is that IVX Autonomous becomes the permanent engineering system for IVX Holdings, and the Rork workspace is no longer required for day-to-day development or operations.
